notes.title: Demo Update 02.06.25 | New animations and weapon types
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730765/ca917de5c0aead91af3e2d9a6333ea68866a74c8.png[/img]

This update reworks 80% of the battle animations, as well as adding new ones for new weapons. Some points in the animations will still be corrected in the future, but I am already happy with the current result, as it is much nicer than what was before.
Bugs may well be encountered, please report if you find them 🙂
I've also laid a couple of foundations for future improvements, so the plan is that I'll continue to do combat improvements for a while longer

[b]Features:[/b]
New weapon types. Polearms, TwoHanded Swords, Axes and Polearms. (I recommend you try it in Custom Battle)
10+ new weapons
20+ new animations for weapons
The player can now lean in during combat to better aim weapons
Improved system for attaching weapons to the fighter

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Fixed hardlock on global map when bandits attacked a player

notes.title: Demo Update 02.04.25 | New maps
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730765/040ff292d68ee5a40e0ba11aaeb8339c77f52a2f.png[/img]

This update is partly experimental because the past map for combat was only 500 by 500 metres. The new maps are 500x500, 1000x1000 and 2000x2000 respectively. This means that the large map is 16 (!) times larger than the grass field map. In terms of performance, the difference is minimal, but we need playtests. I will most likely only use 1x1 and 2x2 km maps in the future.

[b]Features:[/b]
1 new biome for combat and 3 new maps of different sizes.
The game's start loading screen has been added again. Should be less GPU complaints 🙂
DLSS support added. I myself prefer to play without it since I have a FullHD monitor, but you can now enable it.
Made it so that item information in inventory appears on the side. It's more convenient that way

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Fixed incorrect position of the sun on the global map after combat
Reduced rotation speed of units around themselves

notes.title: Mainland Demo with co-op is now available!
notes.notes:
Greetings, strangers!

I'm AddRaiser, the sole developer of Mainland.
I'm glad to welcome you to the demo version of my game.
Since this is my first demo launch - I'd like to say a few words about the game and what you can expect from it now and in the future.

First of all, Mainland is a game inspired by the Mount and Blade series, so if you have experience playing it, you will be quite familiar with many of the game's mechanics. And it's unlikely that you'll find much new for you in the single-player Mainland at the moment.

In any case, the demo version already has co-operative play, so anyone can have a little fun.

It's still quite an early version of the game, so it's quite likely to encounter a bug. I fixed many of them after the closed alpha test, but some obviously still remain.
If you come across one, please report it in the [url=https://discord.gg/ZkU7gN6ZMt]Discord[/url] channel if possible. 
I try to fix them as soon as possible and your actions will help to make the game better.

Also in [url=https://discord.gg/ZkU7gN6ZMt]Discord[/url] there is a channel with suggestions on gameplay and in general with discussion of the game, including Roadmap.
In general, I will be glad if you join the community. There's still a lot of things to do for the game ahead.

I hope you enjoy the game and see its potential as I see it.
See you around, stranger
